notes: Mobile Harness Code — v1.11.0: adds a Signing Key Vault (create/import/export/backup/restore signing keys, RSA & EC, JKS & PKCS12) and in-process signing & verification of arbitrary APK (v1/v2/v3/v4), AAB and split (APKS/XAPK/APKM) files — powered by the official Android apksig library and BouncyCastle, ported from Signiffia (Apache-2.0). The existing release pipeline, Compose, XML, Web App, ZIP import, Android SDK, PRoot, Gradle and plugin system are unchanged. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2, production key) so OEM installers (vivo/OPPO) that reject V3-only APKs accept it; install mobile-harness-online.apk.
